title: Medical Report Information Extractor: on-premises LLM extraction of structured data from pathology reports and discharge summaries
description: A Streamlit application for extracting structured data from free-text medical documents (pathology reports and discharge summaries) with large language models. Extraction tasks are defined by configurable JSON Schemas and instructions. For patient data, it runs entirely on-premises with local open-weight models (Ollama, LM Studio or other OpenAI-compatible servers) and on-device OCR for scanned PDFs, so no document text leaves the hospital. It supports lymphoma registries by pre-filling REDCap registration forms for data-manager verification.
